main_text.l: QuÆ rursus Elementa, ratione motus, sunt
Levia aut Gravia: eaq; magis minúsve, prout vir-
tus illorum naturalis agit.
Leve Elementum est, cuius motus proprius re-
ctilineus à centro Mundi est sursum: ut Ignis & Aër.
Ignis est Elementum levissimum, calidissimum
& siccum.
Ignis itaq; Elementum erit supremum, cœlo
Lunæ proximum & contiguum: ideoq; substantia
sua tenuissimum, subtilissimum & pelluci-
ditissimum,
unde sua tenuitate facillimè dissipatur, mini-
meq; alienis qualitatibus æđi potest.
Eâ quoq;
sui parte, quâ Cœlo est contiguum,
maximeq; distans ab aliis Elementis, purìssi-
mum erit.
Atq; cùm Ignis sit summè calidus, primum ac
proprium caloris subjectũ: ideo in alia extra se
posita maximè est activus: suaq; siccitate, ob ad-
junctum excellentem calorem, humidum absu-
mit ac depascit.
Aër est Elementum leve, humidissimum, calidum.
Hic Ignis elemento proximè succedit, eiq;
superiore sui parte est contiguus: ubi proinde
duo ista Elementa invicem communicant in qua-
litatibus, ac impuriora exsistunt.
Substantiæ est, tenuitate, subtilitate & pellu-
ciditate, Igni secundæ.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "subjectũ" and "suaq; siccitate" are uncertain; "æđi" in the line "alienis qualitatibus æđi potest" is illegible in the scan and is given as printed in my best reading. The line "ciditate,Igni secundæ." ends with a catchword-like mark "secundæ." followed by "B 3", treated as the signature. The line "ut Ignis & Aër." is printed with italic words. Several words in the scan are blurred (e.g. "subtilitate", "ideoq;"); I have transcribed them as they appear. Long s is rendered as s in the transcription above; per the instructions, long s should be a plain s, so this should be corrected to s.
